accepted_boundary_category.treatment: exclude from goal-on-logit-xG fit and report count separately

mathematical_basis: The frozen estimator regresses outcomes on logit(p)=log(p/(1-p)); finite logits require 0<p<1. PitchAPI own goals with xG=0 are not modelled shooting chances, so they are a distinct event category rather than observations to clip into the shot-xG calibration model.

A_deterministic_epsilon_clipping.bias: assigns invented finite log-odds to structural own-goal zeros and changes intercept/slope as a function of epsilon
A_deterministic_epsilon_clipping.numerical_stability: stable only after an arbitrary epsilon is frozen

B_sample_size_clipping.bias: assigns sample-size-dependent invented log-odds and makes the diagnostic depend on group size
B_sample_size_clipping.exact_rule_considered: p_cal=min(max(p,1/(2*n)),1-1/(2*n)), where n is the calibration-group size
B_sample_size_clipping.numerical_stability: stable for n>0 but changes across domains and samples

C_boundary_supporting_estimator.bias: estimator-dependent and would change an otherwise valid frozen diagnostic
C_boundary_supporting_estimator.interpretability: potentially valid for genuine predictive boundary probabilities, but not needed for non-shot own goals
C_boundary_supporting_estimator.numerical_stability: requires a separately specified and qualified estimator

D_explicit_boundary_category.bias: does not invent shot probabilities; fit estimates apply only to ordinary shot observations
D_explicit_boundary_category.interpretability: high because own goals are reported as a separate provider-defined category
D_explicit_boundary_category.numerical_stability: finite logits only; unsupported boundaries fail closed
